items.title: Lockheed Wins Slew Of Contracts. Air Force Doles Out $920 Mil Award.
items.summary: The Department of Defense awarded Lockheed Martin multiple contracts worth over $152 million. The Air Force taps 24 companies for a $920 million award.

items.title: North America’s Only Cesium Project Moves Closer to Production
items.summary: Power Metals is advancing the Case Lake project as a potential new North American source of cesium as governments seek secure supplies of strategic critical minerals.

items.title: Boeing Stock Commands a Massive Premium: Is It Truly Earned?
items.summary: Boeing's growth is flying higher than its rivals, but its stock price is already in the stratosphere. Is the premium justified.

items.title: Tomahawk Missile Production Is Surging—and These Stocks Could Benefit
items.summary: RTX won a $22.9 billion Navy contract aimed at dramatically increasing Tomahawk missile production. L3Harris, General Dynamics, and other defense companies could benefit from the ramp-up.

items.title: RTX, Pentagon Sign $23 Billion Tomahawk Missile Contract
items.summary: The Department of Defense has been pushing contractors to ramp up production of critical munitions. RTX stock rose about 1% on Monday.

items.title: United Launch Alliance names new CEO amid Vulcan rocket travails
items.summary: Longtime United Launch Alliance President and CEO Tory Bruno jumped ship right before Christmas last year, moving on to work with Blue Origin. After eight months of interim leadership, ULA has named Mark Peller as his replacement. items.title: Rocket Lab Stock's Next Leg Rides On A Vehicle That Has Not Flown Yet
items.summary: Rocket Lab's backlog is expected to convert into revenue faster than it was, and the vehicle that would compound that has not yet left the ground.

items.title: 1 Unpopular Stock That Should Get More Attention and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: Wall Street has issued downbeat forecasts for the stocks in this article. These predictions are rare - financial institutions typically hesitate to say bad things about a company because it can jeopardize their other revenue-generating business lines like M&A advisory.
